$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the public component count. Every folder in src/components must appear in exactly one of these lists; scripts/validate-component-registry.mjs enforces this at build time. Import COMPONENT_COUNT from src/components/registry.ts wherever a count is displayed - never hardcode the number.

categories.label: Actions
categories.description: Buttons, button groups, and toggles for triggering actions and switching modes.

categories.label: AI
categories.description: Chat, agent, and model surfaces for building AI products, from the composer to the reasoning trace and the diff an agent proposes.

categories.label: Charts
categories.description: Data visualisation components for plotting series and activity over time.

categories.label: Data display
categories.description: Cards, tables, lists, and badges for presenting structured content.

categories.label: Effects
categories.description: Ambient and decorative surfaces that sit behind or around the interface.

categories.label: Feedback
categories.description: Alerts, toasts, progress, and empty states that tell people what is happening.

categories.label: Forms
categories.description: Inputs, pickers, and selection controls for collecting and editing values.

categories.label: Inspector
categories.description: One-row controls for tool panels and settings rails, each carrying its name inside the control and sized to match Button.

categories.label: Layout
categories.description: Page scaffolding: app shells, sidebars, dividers, and section headings.

categories.label: Maps
categories.description: Geographic surfaces for showing where things are and what connects them: a globe, a flat world map, and the callout and key that explain them.

categories.label: Navigation
categories.description: Top bars, breadcrumbs, tabs, steppers, and pagination for moving through a product.

categories.label: Overlays
categories.description: Dialogs, drawers, menus, and tooltips that float above the page.

categories.label: Typography
categories.description: Headings, running text, links, and lists, each drawn from a tier of the type scale.

components.name: Accordion
components.label: Accordion
components.description: Collapsible content sections for organising related information.

components.name: ActionCard
components.label: Action card
components.description: A change an assistant proposes and the reader confirms, then the record of what happened, with Undo while it can be reversed.

alternatives.name: DecisionRow
alternatives.when: the item sits in a list on the page, waiting on the reader’s yes or no

components.name: ActionReadout
components.label: Action readout
components.description: What a confirmed change did: a title over a list of facts, worked out from the records as they were just before it.

components.name: AgentPlan
components.label: Agent plan
components.description: A collapsible checklist of an agent's task, with live step states and a progress readout.

alternatives.name: Checklist
alternatives.when: the tasks are the reader’s own to tick off, each with an owner

components.name: AgentRail
components.label: Agent rail
components.description: The companion rail of an agent product: the agent's portrait over tabbed panes for activity, approvals, automations, and personalization.

components.name: AgentStatus
components.label: Agent status
components.description: What an agent is doing right now, as a dot matrix and status line, a floating pill, a square mark for icon slots, or a ring around any element.

components.name: AiButton
components.label: AI button
components.description: The AI entry point: a turning gradient ring that reports the agent's status, with a hover-summoned summary and a panel for what the agent asks of you.

partPatterns.part: button that opens the request field

components.name: Alert
components.label: Alert
components.description: Contextual feedback with status variants, optional dismiss, and compact sizing.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.label: Alert dialog
components.description: Modal confirmation overlay with title, description, and confirm / cancel actions.

alternatives.name: Dialog
alternatives.when: the task needs more than a confirm or a cancel

components.name: AnchorNav
components.label: Anchor nav
components.description: An on-page list of anchor links that tracks the reader's position, listed by hand or read from the page's headings.

components.name: AnimatedNumber
components.label: Animated number
components.description: A number that counts to its value: count-up on mount, eased tweens on change, tabular digits that never jitter.

components.name: AppLayout
components.label: App layout
components.description: Full-page template pairing the collapsible App sidebar with a content area, in flush, floating or inset mode, contained or full width.

keys.note: The rail is AppSidebar, which carries the layout’s keys. The layout adds none of its own.

alternatives.name: SiteLayout
alternatives.when: the page is a site of pages under a top header, such as documentation

components.name: AppSidebar
components.label: App sidebar
components.description: Collapsible navigation rail with accordion sub-items, a side panel for a third level, category headings, and a profile section.

keys.note: Below the mobile breakpoint the rail is a modal drawer: opening moves focus inside, Tab stays inside, and Escape closes it.

components.name: AreaChart
components.label: Area chart
components.description: Filled area chart for showing volume over time, with stacked and single-series variants.

keys.note: The chart takes focus and the arrow keys step through its data points, which is the charting engine’s own keyboard layer.

components.name: ArtifactCard
components.label: Artifact card
components.description: The tile a chat leaves in the thread for something it made, a toggle that opens the artifact in its panel.

components.name: ArtifactPanel
components.label: Artifact panel
components.description: A preview with its source a switch away: the panel a chat opens beside the conversation, or an inline live example on a page.

components.name: AttachmentDropZone
components.label: Attachment drop zone
components.description: A wrapper that makes a whole surface a file drop target, with an outlined overlay while files hover over it.

components.name: AttachmentGroup
components.label: Attachment group
components.description: The files on a sent message: one picture at its own shape, or a grid of tiles that collapses behind a count.

partPatterns.part: control that shows the rest of the files

components.name: AttachmentTile
components.label: Attachment tile
components.description: One file as a square: a picture, a coloured mark for well-known formats, or a neutral badge, with upload states.

alternatives.name: FileRow
alternatives.when: the file is one of a list of documents, read as rows

components.name: AttachmentViewer
components.label: Attachment viewer
components.description: A preview dialog for a message's files, with download, stepping, and plain states for files it cannot show.

components.name: Avatar
components.label: Avatar
components.description: A person's or an organisation's image, with initials and icon fallback, a status indicator, and multiple sizes.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.label: Avatar group
components.description: Overlapping avatar stack with a +N counter for the overflow.

components.name: BackToTop
components.label: Back to top
components.description: A round button in the page's corner that appears on a long scroll and takes the reader back to the top.

keys.note: A native button: the browser owns Enter and Space, and the press scrolls the page.

components.name: Badge
components.label: Badge
components.description: Small inline status labels with info, positive, warning, error, and neutral variants.

components.name: Banner
components.label: Banner
components.description: Full-width status strip for page-level announcements, with an action slot and optional dismissal.

components.name: BarChart
components.label: Bar chart
components.description: Vertical bars for comparing values across categories or time, with summary stats and tooltips.

keys.note: The chart takes focus and the arrow keys step through its data points, which is the charting engine’s own keyboard layer.

components.name: BentoTile
components.label: Bento tile
components.description: A feature tile for a bento grid, with a safe content area, a shader pair, solid or transparent background, and an overlay it opens into.

components.name: BentoTileArt
components.label: Bento tile art
components.description: The texture half of a bento tile's shader pair: six fine patterns in one vocabulary, fading in from a corner.

components.name: BottomNav
components.label: Bottom nav
components.description: Mobile tab bar for three to five destinations, in the Rift style or as iOS Liquid Glass or Material 3 Expressive.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.label: Breadcrumb
components.description: Hierarchical navigation trail showing the user's location within the site.

components.name: Button
components.label: Button
components.description: Primary, secondary and tertiary emphasis, each in a default, neutral or destructive tone, with icons, loading, and default and compact sizes.

alternatives.name: IconButton
alternatives.when: the action is an icon alone and should name itself on hover

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.label: Button group
components.description: Horizontal and vertical button group layouts for related actions and navigation patterns.

components.name: Card
components.label: Card
components.description: A titled preview tile for index grids, with a case-study variant carrying a cover, company logo and dek.

components.name: CardStack
components.label: Card stack
components.description: A deck of cards showing one at a time, flipped through with a lift-and-settle animation.

keys.note: With the stack focused, the arrow keys step to the next card and back, and Space and Enter also advance.

components.name: Carousel
components.label: Carousel
components.description: Sliding content viewer with navigation arrows, dot indicators, auto-play, and keyboard support.

components.name: ChatHeader
components.label: Chat header
components.description: The top row of a chat surface, with the conversation title and its controls.

components.name: ChatMarker
components.label: Chat marker
components.description: An inline conversation separator for date breaks and system notes.

components.name: ChatMessage
components.label: Chat message
components.description: A single chat turn with avatar, author, timestamp, and bubble or plain content aligned by role.

components.name: ChatThread
components.label: Chat thread
components.description: A scrollable conversation column with edge fades, send anchoring, and a subtle scrollbar.

keys.note: A focusable scroll region: the browser scrolls it with the arrow, Page, Home and End keys.

components.name: Checkbox
components.label: Checkbox
components.description: Custom checkbox with check and indeterminate states, keyboard accessible with animated transitions.

alternatives.name: RadioButton
alternatives.when: only one option can be chosen

components.name: Checklist
components.label: Checklist
components.description: Tasks with a done state each, an owner and an action, under a count done and a progress bar.

alternatives.name: AgentPlan
alternatives.when: the list is an agent’s plan that it works through itself, with live step states

components.name: Chip
components.label: Chip
components.description: Compact pills for attributes, filters, and inline metadata.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.label: Code block
components.description: Monospace code with a header and one-click copy, optional highlighting, line numbers and tabs.

components.name: CodeDiff
components.label: Code diff
components.description: Unified diff view for code changes, with added, removed, and context lines.

keys.note: A focusable scroll region: the browser scrolls it with the arrow, Page, Home and End keys.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.label: Colour picker
components.description: Swatch trigger opening a saturation area, hue and alpha sliders, and a hex field; controlled or uncontrolled.

keys.note: Opening moves focus onto the colour area, where the arrow keys move both axes, Home and End take saturation to its ends, and Escape closes the panel.

components.name: ComboChart
components.label: Combo chart
components.description: Bar and line series in one chart, with an optional second y-axis for pairs in different units, like spend and ROAS.

keys.note: The chart takes focus and the arrow keys step through its data points, which is the charting engine’s own keyboard layer.

components.name: Combobox
components.label: Combobox
components.description: A filterable select that narrows options as the user types, with multi-select chips, grouping, and async loading.

alternatives.name: Dropdown
alternatives.when: the option list is short and static

alternatives.name: TagInput
alternatives.when: the entries are free text

components.name: CommandPalette
components.label: Command palette
components.description: A modal Cmd+K launcher that searches a grouped command list, with keyboard navigation and shortcut hints.

components.name: CommandPaletteTrigger
components.label: Command palette trigger
components.description: The entry point to a command palette: a button dressed as a search field, with the shortcut's keycaps, at the row-control height.

components.name: Composer
components.label: Composer
components.description: An auto-growing message input with send and stop states, a page-context note, a file tray fed by picker, paste and drop, and Enter-to-send.

keys.note: Enter sends, Shift and Enter adds a line, and with a mention list open the arrow keys move through it, Enter or Tab writes the choice and Escape closes it.

components.name: ContactCard
components.label: Contact card
components.description: Linked contact method with icon, label, and value.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.label: Context menu
components.description: Right-click menu at the pointer with groups, sub-menus, and shortcut hints.

alternatives.name: DropdownMenu
alternatives.when: the menu opens from a visible trigger

components.name: ContributionGraph
components.label: Contribution graph
components.description: A year of activity, one cell per day.

components.name: CopyButton
components.label: Copy button
components.description: A button that puts a value on the clipboard and confirms it, with text or as an icon alone.

alternatives.name: IconButton
alternatives.when: the button runs an action other than copying a value

components.name: CurrencyInput
components.label: Currency input
components.description: An amount of money as a decimal string, read in the locale's marks and grouped once the field is left.

keys.note: Arrow Up and Arrow Down step the amount by its step, between its minimum and maximum.

components.name: DataTable
components.label: Data table
components.description: The wired table: typed columns, sorting, filters, editing, grouping with totals, row details, saved views, thousands of rows, and rows from a server.

keys.note: In grid navigation the arrow keys move between cells, Enter or F2 starts an edit and Escape cancels it. The page has the full table of keys.

alternatives.name: Table
alternatives.when: the rows are static and only need laying out

components.name: DateInput
components.label: Date input
components.description: Date input with native picker, calendar icon, label, and validation states.

keys.note: A native date input: the browser owns its keys and its picker.

components.name: DatePicker
components.label: Date picker
components.description: Inline calendar with month navigation, day selection, and today indicator.

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.label: Date range picker
components.description: An inline calendar for choosing a range of days, one or two months wide, with presets.

components.name: Deadline
components.label: Deadline
components.description: A due date against now that turns from neutral to warning to error as it nears.

components.name: DecisionRow
components.label: Decision row
components.description: One item waiting on a yes or a no, as a list row that settles to the decision taken, with Undo while it can be reversed.

alternatives.name: ActionCard
alternatives.when: an assistant proposes the change in a chat reply

alternatives.name: Widget
alternatives.when: the rows only report or link, with no decision to take

components.name: DescriptionList
components.label: Description list
components.description: Terms and their values for review screens, receipts, and account details, stacked, in two columns, or in a grid.

components.name: Dialog
components.label: Dialog
components.description: A general-purpose modal for focused tasks, with sizes, an optional footer, and full focus management.

alternatives.name: AlertDialog
alternatives.when: the task is a simple confirm-or-cancel prompt

components.name: Divider
components.label: Divider
components.description: A thin rule separating stacked content, with optional inline label and vertical orientation.

components.name: DocumentChip
components.label: Document chip
components.description: A legacy one-row file reference, superseded by the attachment tile and kept for existing consumers.

components.name: DocumentViewer
components.label: Document viewer
components.description: A PDF, an image or a text file shown on the page, with download and a fallback where the browser will not embed it.

keys.note: A focusable scroll region: the browser scrolls it with the arrow, Page, Home and End keys.

components.name: Drawer
components.label: Drawer
components.description: An edge-anchored modal panel that slides in from any side, for filter panels, detail views, and mobile navigation.

components.name: Dropdown
components.label: Dropdown
components.description: Custom select dropdown with keyboard navigation, disabled options, and error states.

alternatives.name: Combobox
alternatives.when: the option list is long, searchable or server-backed

alternatives.name: DropdownMenu
alternatives.when: the options are actions, not a form value

alternatives.name: RadioButton
alternatives.when: the options are few enough to show all at once

alternatives.name: RichDropdown
alternatives.when: the whole look of each choice is the point, such as a theme preset or a brand kit

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.label: Dropdown menu
components.description: Action menu opened from a trigger, with groups, sub-menus, shortcuts, radio and checkbox items, placed to stay on screen.

alternatives.name: ContextMenu
alternatives.when: the menu opens on the content itself

alternatives.name: Dropdown
alternatives.when: the choice is a form value

alternatives.name: Menubar
alternatives.when: several menus sit side by side in a persistent bar

components.name: EmptyState
components.label: Empty state
components.description: The placeholder for a list, table, or search with nothing to show, or the result at the end of a flow: icon, headline, guidance, and a next action.

components.name: EntityCard
components.label: Entity card
components.description: Compact display-only card with a centred icon or image and a label, used in the Icons and Logos galleries.

components.name: EntitySwitcher
components.label: Entity switcher
components.description: Switcher for the company, team, or account a screen is scoped to, with a logo, icon, or initials mark and levels that drill in.

components.name: ErrorSummary
components.label: Error summary
components.description: Every error on a form at the top of it, each a link that moves focus to its field.

components.name: EventCalendar
components.label: Event calendar
components.description: A month, a week or a day of events: pills on their days, overflow counts in the month, a legend that can filter, and a panel for the chosen day.

components.name: Field
components.label: Field
components.description: The shared scaffolding for labelled form controls: label, required marker, helper and error text, and the ARIA wiring that ties them together.

components.name: Figure
components.label: Figure
components.description: Images with captions, in the case-study frame, with a Do or Don't verdict for guidelines.

components.name: FileInput
components.label: File input
components.description: A click-or-drop upload zone paired with a controlled file list showing size, progress, and per-file errors.

components.name: FileRow
components.label: File row
components.description: One file in a list: its type mark, its name as a link or a button, a line of detail and controls at the end.

keys.note: The name is a native link or button and the actions passed in are native controls, reached with Tab.

alternatives.name: AttachmentTile
alternatives.when: the file sits on a chat message or in a composer, shown as a square

components.name: FilterBar
components.label: Filter bar
components.description: A row of filter chips for narrowing a collection, each opening a popover of options, with per-filter and clear-all resets.

components.name: FormSection
components.label: Form section
components.description: A part of a form or a settings page: a heading and its sentence, the fields in a grid, and the section’s own actions.

keys.note: It holds the fields and actions passed in, each a native control reached with Tab.

alternatives.name: Widget
alternatives.when: the section is a dashboard tile rather than part of a form

components.name: FunnelChart
components.label: Funnel chart
components.description: Ordered funnel stages as centred trapezoid bands, each sized by its share of the first stage.

keys.note: The chart takes focus and the arrow keys step through its data points, which is the charting engine’s own keyboard layer.

components.name: GanttChart
components.label: Gantt chart
components.description: Phases and tasks as bars on a shared timeline, with milestones, progress, and a today rule.

alternatives.name: ResourceTimeline
alternatives.when: the bars run over hours within one day

components.name: Gauge
components.label: Gauge
components.description: A radial dial for a single bounded reading, recoloured through the status roles as it crosses thresholds.

components.name: Globe
components.label: Globe
components.description: An orthographic globe with markers and great-circle arcs, rotated by drag, keys, or a slow spin.

keys.note: The arrow keys turn the globe while it has focus.

components.name: Grid
components.label: Grid
components.description: Equal columns that fold by their own width, with a gap from the scale and cells that share a row’s height.

alternatives.name: Stack
alternatives.when: the children run in one line, a column or a row, rather than in equal columns

alternatives.name: Widget
alternatives.when: the board is of Widget tiles of different heights that should pack without holes

components.name: Heading
components.label: Heading
components.description: A heading whose outline level and type tier are chosen apart, with an optional link to itself.

components.name: HoverCard
components.label: Hover card
components.description: Rich preview panel that opens from hover or focus, with interactive content and position options.

components.name: Icon
components.label: Icon
components.description: One Material Symbol on the icon scale, decorative or named, plain or on a round tile.

components.name: IconButton
components.label: Icon button
components.description: Icon-only button in primary, secondary and tertiary emphasis and a default, neutral or destructive tone, in default and compact sizes.

alternatives.name: Button
alternatives.when: the action needs its words on show, with or without an icon beside them

alternatives.name: CopyButton
alternatives.when: the button puts a value on the clipboard and should confirm it

components.name: ImageCompare
components.label: Image compare
components.description: Before-and-after image comparison with a draggable divider, keyboard control, and corner labels.

components.name: Input
components.label: Input
components.description: Text input with label, placeholder, icons, a prefix or suffix, a clear button, helper text, and error states.

alternatives.name: Textarea
alternatives.when: the content needs more than one line

components.name: InspectorColorPicker
components.label: Inspector colour picker
components.description: One-row colour setting for inspector panels, with the hex and a round swatch at the bar's end and ColorPicker's own panel.

keys.note: It is ColorPicker in the inspector’s dress: opening moves focus onto the colour area, where the arrow keys move both axes, and Escape closes the panel with focus back on the swatch.

components.name: InspectorDropdown
components.label: Inspector dropdown
components.description: One-row select for inspector panels, with the name inside the bar and the library Dropdown's menu and font previews.

components.name: InspectorInput
components.label: Inspector input
components.description: One-row text field for inspector panels, with the name on the left and the value right-aligned in the bar.

components.name: InspectorSection
components.label: Inspector section
components.description: Collapsible, titled run of inspector controls whose open body lets a dropdown menu open past its edge.

components.name: InspectorSegmentedControl
components.label: Inspector segments
components.description: One-row choice between a few options for inspector panels, as native radios under a sliding selection pill.

keys.note: Native radio inputs: the browser moves between them with the arrow keys.

components.name: InspectorSlider
components.label: Inspector slider
components.description: One-row slider for inspector panels, where the whole bar is the control and its fill is the value.

keys.note: A native range input: the browser’s own arrow, Home, End and Page keys move it.

components.name: InspectorToggleSwitch
components.label: Inspector toggle switch
components.description: One-row switch for inspector panels, where the whole bar toggles and the track sits at its end.

components.name: Instructions
components.label: Instructions
components.description: Step-by-step guidance with numbered badges, connecting lines, and horizontal layout.

components.name: InterruptCard
components.label: Interrupt card
components.description: A human-in-the-loop checkpoint with a question from the agent and option buttons to decide.

components.name: Kbd
components.label: Kbd
components.description: A keyboard key rendered as a keycap, for shortcut hints in menus and prose.

components.name: LegendTile
components.label: Legend tile
components.description: The labelled value tile under a chart: a series dot, the series name, and its reading, on a soft neutral fill.

components.name: Lightbox
components.label: Lightbox
components.description: Fullscreen media viewer on the shared overlay stack: deep scrim, caption chip, gallery stepping, trapped and restored focus.

components.name: LineChart
components.label: Line chart
components.description: Multi-series line chart for trends over time, with per-series colours and a summary row.

keys.note: The chart takes focus and the arrow keys step through its data points, which is the charting engine’s own keyboard layer.

components.name: Link
components.label: Link
components.description: A text link inside a sentence, on its own, or skipping to the content, routed through the app's link component.

components.name: LinkList
components.label: Link list
components.description: Linked items with logo, label, and subtitle.

components.name: List
components.label: List
components.description: Ordered and unordered lists marked with a disc, a number, a check, or an icon.

components.name: MapCallout
components.label: Map callout
components.description: The annotation beside a map point: a name in capitals over monospace readout lines.

components.name: MapLegend
components.label: Map legend
components.description: The corner block of a map: its name, what it shows, and the key to its markers.

components.name: MaskedInput
components.label: Masked input
components.description: A field that writes its value into a shape as it is typed, with a sensitive mode that hides it.

components.name: MegaMenu
components.label: Mega menu
components.description: A wide navigation panel of icon rows with descriptions, beside an optional featured card.

components.name: Mention
components.label: Mention
components.description: An inline reference to an entity or a skill, with the menu that @ or / opens while typing and the tag it leaves in the message.

keys.note: The list of suggestions is driven from the field it belongs to: the arrow keys move, Enter chooses and Escape closes.

components.name: Menubar
components.label: Menu bar
components.description: A persistent row of menus, like an app's File, Edit and View, with arrow keys along the bar.

alternatives.name: Toolbar
alternatives.when: the bar holds controls that act at once rather than menus

alternatives.name: DropdownMenu
alternatives.when: one menu opens from one trigger

components.name: MessageActions
components.label: Message actions
components.description: An icon-button row for message-level actions like copy, retry, and feedback.

components.name: MessageCard
components.label: Message card
components.description: A structured rich-content card embedded in a chat message, with media, title, body, and actions.

components.name: Meter
components.label: Meter
components.description: Level indicator for a known quantity, with a status-coloured fill and an optional value readout.

components.name: ModelPicker
components.label: Model picker
components.description: A model selector for chat surfaces, with per-model descriptions and an optional effort row.

components.name: Nav
components.label: Nav
components.description: A legacy plain top bar of brand and page links, superseded by the site header and kept for existing consumers.

components.name: NavList
components.label: Nav list
components.description: Vertical navigation links for drawers and long sidebars: sections, three indent levels, expand toggles, a compact size and its own scroll.

components.name: NotificationCenter
components.label: Notification centre
components.description: A persistent notification inbox with unread count, filter tabs, and per-item actions.

components.name: NumberInput
components.label: Number input
components.description: Numeric field with increment and decrement steppers and min/max clamping.

components.name: OrgChart
components.label: Org chart
components.description: Who reports to whom: each person a card with their avatar, name and role, their reports in a row beneath.

keys.note: Each person whose name links to a profile is a native link, reached with Tab.

alternatives.name: TreeView
alternatives.when: the hierarchy is a list to navigate and fold rather than people drawn as a chart

components.name: PageHeader
components.label: Page header
components.description: The top of a page: its breadcrumb, title, description and actions, folding the actions under the text when narrow.

keys.note: Its breadcrumb links and the actions passed in are native links and buttons, reached with Tab.

alternatives.name: SectionTitle
alternatives.when: the heading opens a section within a page rather than the page itself

components.name: Pagination
components.label: Pagination
components.description: Numbered page navigation with ellipses and a compact readout, or links to the previous and next page of a sequence.

components.name: Panel
components.label: Panel
components.description: The plain dashboard surface: a rounded container with padding and a gap, borderless unless it needs an edge.

components.name: PieChart
components.label: Pie chart
components.description: Proportional share of a whole as a pie or donut, with per-slice colours.

keys.note: The chart takes focus and the arrow keys step through its data points, which is the charting engine’s own keyboard layer.

components.name: PinInput
components.label: Pin input
components.description: Segmented one-time-code input with auto-advance, paste support, and completion callback.

keys.note: Typing fills a cell and moves on, Backspace clears and steps back, and the arrow keys move between cells.

components.name: PixelAvatar
components.label: Pixel avatar
components.description: A generated character mark drawn from a name: the same name is always the same pixel creature in the same ink.

components.name: Popover
components.label: Popover
components.description: Contextual overlay panel with click and hover triggers, positioned relative to its anchor.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.label: Progress bar
components.description: Horizontal bar indicating completion progress, with an optional percentage label.

alternatives.name: Spinner
alternatives.when: the wait is indeterminate

components.name: ProgressiveBlur
components.label: Progressive blur
components.description: A backdrop blur that dissolves along one edge, with an optional page tint that fades in.

components.name: PromptSuggestions
components.label: Prompt suggestions
components.description: Tappable prompt suggestions to start or steer a conversation, as a scrolling or wrapping row, a stack, tiles or cards.

components.name: Prose
components.label: Prose
components.description: Token-styled typography for rendered markdown and rich agent output.

components.name: QuestionCard
components.label: Question card
components.description: An agent's question with answers to pick: one or several, a set asked a step at a time, kept as a record once answered.

keys.note: The digits pick an option by its position, and Enter or Space choose the focused one. A lone question answers on the pick, and a set or a multiple-choice question on its button.

components.name: Quote
components.label: Quote
components.description: Blockquotes and pull-quotes with attribution.

components.name: RadarChart
components.label: Radar chart
components.description: Multi-axis comparison of series across categories on a radial grid.

keys.note: The chart takes focus and the arrow keys step through its data points, which is the charting engine’s own keyboard layer.

components.name: RadialChart
components.label: Radial chart
components.description: Concentric progress rings for completion and KPI readouts.

keys.note: The chart takes focus and the arrow keys step through its data points, which is the charting engine’s own keyboard layer.

components.name: RadioButton
components.label: Radio button
components.description: Radio button and radio group with vertical and horizontal layouts, animated dot indicator.

alternatives.name: Checkbox
alternatives.when: users can select more than one

alternatives.name: Dropdown
alternatives.when: the list of options is long

components.name: Rating
components.label: Rating
components.description: Star-scale rating or a thumbs up and down verdict, with keyboard selection and a read-only mode.

components.name: Reasoning
components.label: Reasoning
components.description: A model's thinking, disclosed behind a one-line summary and collapsed once it finishes.

components.name: ResourceTimeline
components.label: Resource timeline
components.description: Hours within one day: a row per person or resource and a bar from each start to its end, on an axis of hours.

alternatives.name: GanttChart
alternatives.when: the bars run over days and months rather than hours within one day

components.name: RichDropdown
components.label: Rich dropdown
components.description: Dropdown's rich sibling: options preview their own heading face, body face, and key colour.

alternatives.name: Dropdown
alternatives.when: the label alone is enough to choose by

components.name: ScatterChart
components.label: Scatter chart
components.description: Plots point clusters across two axes to show correlation and distribution.

keys.note: The chart takes focus and the arrow keys step through its data points, which is the charting engine’s own keyboard layer.

components.name: SectionTitle
components.label: Section title
components.description: Heading with a divider line and optional trailing content for organising page sections.

alternatives.name: PageHeader
alternatives.when: the heading is the page’s own title, with its breadcrumb and actions

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.label: Segmented control
components.description: Pill-style toggle between related views with keyboard navigation and icon support.

alternatives.name: Tabs
alternatives.when: the options are distinct content sections with their own panels

components.name: SelectionCard
components.label: Selection card
components.description: Large option cards for high-visibility choices like settings and onboarding, with radio, checkbox or per-card toggle indicators.

components.name: ShaderField
components.label: Shader field
components.description: An ambient WebGL2 field of soft light sources that sample colour tokens, with a reported fallback status.

components.name: ShaderScene
components.label: Shader scene
components.description: A WebGL2 scene, from a night horizon to a spiral galaxy or one of your own in GLSL, in the theme's field colours, with fades, vignette and grain.

components.name: SidebarPanel
components.label: Sidebar panel
components.description: Secondary navigation column listing one section's pages, with group headings and one level of accordion nesting.

components.name: SignaturePad
components.label: Signature pad
components.description: A signature drawn with a pointer or typed, kept as SVG with a PNG on demand.

components.name: SiteFooter
components.label: Site footer
components.description: The bottom of a site: brand, columns of links, and a row of small print and social links.

keys.note: Plain links: the browser owns Tab and Enter.

components.name: SiteHeader
components.label: Site header
components.description: A site's sticky top bar of section pills and mega menus, folding to a drawer when the pills no longer fit or below a set breakpoint.

keys.note: Focusing a section opens its panel, Arrow Down moves into it, and Escape closes it.

components.name: SiteLayout
components.label: Site layout
components.description: The frame of a docs or marketing site: header, sidebar, content, aside and footer, with the page's width and the sidebar's dock set apart.

keys.note: A frame: its slots own their keys, and its skip link is a native link.

alternatives.name: AppLayout
alternatives.when: the page is an app screen with a rail of tools rather than a site of pages

components.name: Skeleton
components.label: Skeleton
components.description: Placeholder loading indicators with text, circular, and rectangular variants.

components.name: Slider
components.label: Slider
components.description: Range input for selecting a value between a minimum and maximum, in default and compact sizes.

keys.note: A native range input: the browser’s own arrow, Home, End and Page keys move it.

components.name: SourceChip
components.label: Source chip
components.description: A numbered citation pill linking a claim to its source.

components.name: SourceTrail
components.label: Source trail
components.description: The sources an agent opened while answering, as a collapsible list with per-item status.

components.name: Sparkline
components.label: Sparkline
components.description: Inline trend line for stats and table cells, drawn without axes or chrome.

components.name: Spinner
components.label: Spinner
components.description: Animated circular loading indicator in three sizes and a default, neutral or inherit tone.

alternatives.name: ProgressBar
alternatives.when: the completion fraction is known

components.name: SplitButton
components.label: Split button
components.description: Primary action with an attached menu of alternatives, composing Button and DropdownMenu in one pill, in primary or secondary emphasis and any tone.

components.name: SplitPane
components.label: Split pane
components.description: Two resizable regions with a draggable, keyboard-operable divider between them.

components.name: Stack
components.label: Stack
components.description: Children in one direction, a column or a row, with a gap from the scale between them.

alternatives.name: Grid
alternatives.when: the children should sit in equal columns that fold by the room the grid has

components.name: StackedBarChart
components.label: Stacked bar chart
components.description: Bars split into stacked segments to compare totals and their composition.

keys.note: The chart takes focus and the arrow keys step through its data points, which is the charting engine’s own keyboard layer.

components.name: Stat
components.label: Stat
components.description: Headline metrics with labels, trend deltas, an optional icon tile and caption, and a slot for a sparkline.

components.name: StatusDot
components.label: Status dot
components.description: The bare status mark: a dot in the five status roles, with an optional label and a live pulse for recording and online-now states.

components.name: Stepper
components.label: Stepper
components.description: Step-by-step progress indicator for wizards and multi-stage flows.

alternatives.name: Wizard
alternatives.when: the steps need their container, their heading and Back and Continue

components.name: StreamingText
components.label: Streaming text
components.description: Progressive reveal for text arriving in chunks, with a blinking cursor while more is coming.

components.name: Swatch
components.label: Swatch
components.description: Clickable colour tile for preset palettes and picker triggers, with a theme-aware selection ring.

components.name: Table
components.label: Table
components.description: Data table with flexible cell content, striped rows, compact sizing, code columns, and support for icons, inputs and controls.

alternatives.name: DataTable
alternatives.when: the rows need sorting, filtering, editing or loading from a server

components.name: TableToolbar
components.label: Table toolbar
components.description: The control bar over a table: search, filter chips, sort, group, columns, density, saved views and a bulk bar, wired to a DataTable in its toolbar slot.

keys.note: Alt and the up or down arrow reorder a column or a sort row, and Escape closes a panel.

components.name: Tabs
components.label: Tabs
components.description: Tabs with an underline indicator, icons and counts, compact and full-width modes, and panels it can render itself.

alternatives.name: SegmentedControl
alternatives.when: the options switch a view mode or a filter

components.name: TagInput
components.label: Tag input
components.description: Multi-value text input with entries held as removable tags.

alternatives.name: Combobox
alternatives.when: the values come from a known option list

components.name: Text
components.label: Text
components.description: Running text in a tier of the type scale, with tones, truncation, and tabular figures.

components.name: Textarea
components.label: Textarea
components.description: Multi-line text input with character counter, resize control, helper text, and error states.

alternatives.name: Input
alternatives.when: the value fits on a single line

components.name: ThemePicker
components.label: Theme picker
components.description: A circular trigger wearing the active theme's swatch, opening a menu of every theme on offer with its colour, corner and faces.

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.label: Theme toggle
components.description: The colour-mode control: System, Light and Dark over a stored setting, with the script that applies it before first paint.

components.name: ThreadPanel
components.label: Thread panel
components.description: The session-history rail for chat products: brand header, new-thread action, standing controls, projects, grouped detail-rich threads, and a profile footer.

keys.note: The rail’s toggle is an ordinary button, and its threads are a list of buttons.

components.name: ThreadTabs
components.label: Thread tabs
components.description: The strip of open chat sessions: pill tabs with status dots and hover-revealed close buttons, a new-tab action, and animated enter and exit.

components.name: TimePicker
components.label: Time picker
components.description: Time-of-day field with a dropdown list of selectable times.

components.name: Timeline
components.label: Timeline
components.description: Ordered sequences: histories and steppers.

components.name: Toast
components.label: Toast
components.description: Temporary notification with status variants, auto-dismiss, and stacking via ToastProvider.

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.label: Toggle group
components.description: A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off, supporting text and icon items.

components.name: ToggleSwitch
components.label: Toggle switch
components.description: Binary on/off toggle control with sliding thumb and check indicator, for settings that take effect immediately.

components.name: ToolCall
components.label: Tool call
components.description: The record of one tool invocation, with its arguments and result behind a disclosure.

components.name: Toolbar
components.label: Toolbar
components.description: A grouped strip of controls in one pill shell: clusters, separators, arrow-key focus, and a glass floating variant.

alternatives.name: Menubar
alternatives.when: the controls are named menus of commands, like an app's File and Edit

components.name: Tooltip
components.label: Tooltip
components.description: Contextual text label that appears on hover or focus with position and delay options.

components.name: TopAppBar
components.label: Top app bar
components.description: Mobile screen header with a menu or back button, title, and actions, in Rift, iOS, or Android style, collapsing on scroll.

components.name: TreeView
components.label: Tree view
components.description: Collapsible hierarchy for files, folders, and nested structures.

alternatives.name: OrgChart
alternatives.when: the hierarchy is people, drawn as a chart of who reports to whom

components.name: Treemap
components.label: Treemap
components.description: Nested rectangles sized by value for part-to-whole breakdowns.

components.name: UsageCard
components.label: Usage card
components.description: An agent's budgets at a glance: context window and plan limits as meter rows with reset captions.

components.name: Waveform
components.label: Waveform
components.description: Voice made visible: a row of bars dancing on the shared twelve-slot cycle, or tracking a live analyser level by level.

components.name: Widget
components.label: Widget
components.description: A titled section for a dashboard or settings, with rows, groups, a footer, an optional fold, and a board of columns.

alternatives.name: Grid
alternatives.when: cells of any kind should sit in equal columns and share a row’s height

alternatives.name: FormSection
alternatives.when: the section holds a form’s fields and its own save

alternatives.name: DecisionRow
alternatives.when: each row waits on a yes or a no and settles to the answer

components.name: Wizard
components.label: Wizard
components.description: A task in steps: the stepper, the step under its heading, and Back and Continue with a running summary.

keys.note: Back, Continue and Finish are native buttons, as are the stepper’s completed steps, and focus moves to each step’s heading.

alternatives.name: Stepper
alternatives.when: only the progress is needed and the host lays out the steps and their buttons

components.name: WorldMap
components.label: World map
components.description: A flat world map from Natural Earth land shapes: token-coloured continents, framed bounds, and colour-carrying markers.

keys.note: With zoom on and the map focused, plus and minus zoom and the arrow keys pan. Its zoom buttons are ordinary buttons.
